name: assessment-paper
title: Draft assessment paper
for_each: select id,code from assessments order by code

sections.title: Staff readiness check
sections.note: Draft for staff review. Resolve readiness gaps before issuing. No answer key is included.

sections.title: Candidate questions
sections.sql: select i.position,q.prompt,q.max_score from assessment_items i join questions q on q.id=i.question_id where i.assessment_id=$1 order by i.position

name: marking-guide
title: Confidential marking guide
for_each: select id,code from assessments order by code

sections.title: Marking criteria
sections.note: Staff only. Keep separate from candidate papers.
sections.sql: select i.position,q.code,q.prompt,q.rubric,q.max_score,q.revision from assessment_items i join questions q on q.id=i.question_id where i.assessment_id=$1 order by i.position

name: moderation-pack
title: Assessment moderation pack
for_each: select id,code from assessments order by code

sections.title: Results
sections.note: A score threshold is not a competency decision. Evidence needs human review.
sections.sql: select r.code,r.participant,r.cohort,r.percent,r.score_band,r.moderation from result_board r join assessments a on a.code=r.assessment where a.id=$1 order by r.code

sections.title: Evidence decisions
sections.sql: select t.code,m.reviewer,m.decision,m.validity,m.sufficiency,m.authenticity,m.currency,m.evidence,m.created_at from moderations m join attempts t on t.id=m.attempt_id where t.assessment_id=$1 order by m.created_at

name: validation-record
title: Validation planning record
for_each: select id,code from programmes order by code

sections.title: Validation history
sections.sql: select reviewer,credentials,evidence,decision,next_due,created_at from validations where programme_id=$1 order by created_at

sections.title: Follow-up
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,due_date,status,closure_note from actions where programme_id=$1 order by due_date
